sample.points: all 10 points present in the recorded forecast set
sample.selection: for each point and date, the first recorded issuance at or after 07:00 and before 12:00 America/New_York; record missing without substituting another day

model_alone.response_schema_revision_note: revision 1 did not fix the hours array length and all 10 of its calls returned one hour; revision 2 requires exactly 48 hours. Sample, prompt, metrics and budget are unchanged.
model_alone.label_input: full saved text-layer pages for all three labels; the saved 264-700 OCR second reading is also shown page by page, matching the compiler pipeline's available readings
model_alone.task: For each hour, say whether this tank may be sprayed according to every label: PERMITTED, BLOCKED or FIELD_CHECK (the forecast cannot decide), with the label sentence and page you relied on.

metrics: agreement matrix model state x planner state, per case and pooled
unsafe go: model PERMITTED and planner BLOCKED, with blocking rule id, parameter, and quote
lost window: model BLOCKED and planner PERMITTED
quote check using compiler.compile_label.guard's whitespace-insensitive page match
station check for each system's PERMITTED hours using tools.checkback.check_permitted_rules
response tokens, latency, and list-price cost per call

budget.policy: stop with a partial receipt before the next call whose conservative maximum would exceed the budget
budget.retries: at most two retries after the first failed attempt, with backoff; every attempt is recorded

preregistration.invalid_output_policy: invalid JSON or an omitted, duplicate, reordered, or wrong-time hour is a failed attempt; never repair by guessing
preregistration.data_policy: recorded label text, NWS forecasts, and station observations only; no synthetic evaluation inputs

run.stop_reason: next call maximum would exceed USD 0.14
